assignments.reason: The refinement of wisdom through the 13 hermeneutical principles. The text explicitly pairs it with wisdom-refinement as two parallel (bechina) manifestations: 'לפי ההזדככות חכמתו... כן הזדככות קול רנתו' (section ד). This is not a separate domain; it is the refined voice itself, the same quality as קול in Package 1.

new_packages.label: שָׁלוֹם
new_packages.reason: Torah #27 treats שלום as a distinct spiritual domain — the state of wholeness and harmony that is the PRODUCT of הדרת פנים but is not itself הדרת פנים. The Torah devotes sections ב, ז, and ח to peace as its own reality: peace in the generation (שלום שבדור), peace in the body, in possessions, in Torah study. Peace is the mediating reality between the inner wisdom-radiance of Package 1 and the outward universal goal of drawing the world to God. Its nature as a separate domain is confirmed by the Torah's statement that peace must be 'clothed in bitterness' (section ז: 'לשלום מר לי מר') — שלום has its own dynamics, its own paradoxes, and its own relationship to healing/medicine, independent of the הדרת פנים cluster.

new_packages.label: תִּקּוּן הַבְּרִית
new_packages.reason: Torah #27 treats תיקון הברית as a foundational spiritual practice with its own internal structure: the prerequisite for הדרת פנים (section ו: 'להדרת פנים אי אפשר לבוא אלא על ידי תיקון הברית'), the process of overcoming temptation (נכנס בו רוח שטות... ומשבר תאותו), the mechanism of extracting fallen sparks (מפיק ומוציא ניצוצי הקדושה), and the principle of תשובת המשקל (repentance of equal measure). These four nodes all belong to the domain of sexual holiness and its rectification — they are not aspects of wisdom-radiance or peace, but of the covenant between human and divine expressed through physical purity. The Zoharic source (בעז = ברית, חדוה דמטרוניתא) confirms this as its own spiritual domain.

new_packages.label: אֱמֶת וַעֲבוֹדַת ה' הַכְּלָלִית
new_packages.reason: Torah #27 opens (section א) with the grand goal: drawing the entire world to serve God (לעבדו שכם אחד), which happens through people investigating and explaining truth to each other, leading each person to cast away the falsehood of idolatry. These concepts form a coherent cluster around אמת (truth) and universal worship — the ultimate PURPOSE that the entire causal chain of the Torah serves. Their essential nature is not peace (which enables them), not wisdom-radiance (which is upstream), but the domain of truth-discovery and monotheistic worship itself. The text frames this as the Torah's messianic horizon: 'כל העולם... יתפללו אל השם יתברך לבד'.
